item.title: Ask the Expert: Inflammatory bowel disease

item.title: Upstate man pleads guilty to 2024 murder
item.description: OCONEE COUNTY, S.C. (WSPA) - An Upstate man will spend over 40 years in prison for fatally shooting a man in the back in Seneca.
